remarks: Set on a 0.65 acre homesite in East Amherst, this proposed custom ranch by Brownstone Homes offers approximately 2,600 sq ft of finished space with 3 bedrooms, 3 full bathrooms, and a flexible layout designed for comfortable everyday living. With undeveloped homesites becoming increasingly difficult to find in East Amherst, this property offers an opportunity to build new while remaining close to shopping, dining, and everyday conveniences. The proposed plan includes approximately 1,800 sq ft on the main level with 2 bedrooms, 2 full bathrooms, a private den that can also function as a home office or additional bedroom, and convenient first floor laundry. An additional approximately 800 finished sq ft includes a third bedroom, full bathroom, and spacious recreation area. The exterior features a stucco front elevation with siding on the remaining sides for a clean, timeless look. Inside, the open design is centered around a spacious great room with a gas fireplace and a well appointed kitchen featuring custom cabinetry, quartz countertops, a large center island, premium kitchen appliances included, and generous pantry space. Brownstone Homes is known for combining thoughtful design with quality materials and craftsmanship, with features such as Andersen windows, engineered hardwood flooring, custom cabinetry, detailed tilework, and carefully selected finishes throughout. Attention to detail extends beyond the finishes, with each home designed and built to create a lasting combination of comfort, function, and quality. Buyers may build the proposed home, customize the floor plan and finishes, or work with Brownstone Homes to create an entirely different custom design suited to their needs. Offered at $1,190,000 including the 0.65 acre lot and proposed home. Taxes TBD. Images shown include AI generated renderings and digitally altered images created to illustrate the proposed home and its potential appearance on the property. Final home, site layout, landscaping, driveway, grading, and exterior features may vary.
